This '''conclave''' took place<ref name="Backlash" /> in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] between the all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Raining Leaves Clan]] and the all-male [[Broken Columns Clan]]. The two Clans were holding the conclave for the possibility of a marriage between their leaders&mdash;Broken Columns' [[Tasander Dest]] and Raining Leaves' [[Kaminne Sihn]]&mdash;in order to merge the two Clans into one new Clan.<ref name="Backlash" />

Meanwhile, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] had arrived on Dathomir on the run after her [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] had been demolished during an [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attack]] on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at [[Sinkhole Station]]. She came under the protection of the Raining Leaves Clan by the time of the arrival of Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Sihn attempted to deter the Skywalkers from traveling through the rain forest as they neared the Clan's territory, and eventually set up an [[Skirmish in the Dathomiri rainforest|ambush]] for them alongside several other Witches. However, the Skywalkers defeated them with the help of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] and the Solos' guides. Upon learning the identity of Luke Skywalker, Sihn decided to allow the Skywalkers, Solos, and their guides to travel with them to the conclave.<ref name="Backlash" />

Upon meeting the Raining Leaves Clan, the Skywalkers discovered that Vestara Khai was in their midst. However, when the Jedi confronted her, the Clan forced them to back down, claiming that they had adopted her. The conclave thus began with the Skywalkers living alongside the Clan, unwilling to leave their quarry. Khai, meanwhile, had contacted the planet's [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] through [[Halliava Vurse]], a Nightsister who was undercover within the Raining Leaves Clan, and arranged a deal with them to exchange information with her [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]].<ref name="Backlash" />

The Nightsisters, who strongly opposed the merging of the Clans, staged several attacks on them during the Conclave. Eventually, the Clans moved the Conclave to a new neutral ground, termed the [[Bright Sun Hill|Jedi Hill Camp]]. There, the two Clans finally merged to become [[Bright Sun Clan]], and the hill was renamed Bright Sun Hill. However, that night, the Nightsisters staged an [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|attack]] on the hill. Despite losing at least 20 Clan members, Bright Sun Clan, along with help from Khai and the Skywalkers, managed to defeat the Nightsisters.<ref name="Backlash" />

Shortly afterward, reinforcements from Khai's Sith Tribe arrived and betrayed and [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] the Nightsisters with whom Khai had promised to exchange [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|techniques]]. The Skywalkers, however, found the Sith and [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|dueled]] with them, defeating them, capturing Khai, and revealing Khai's and Vurse's treachery. The Bright Sun Clan then refuted all responsibility for Khai as a member, finally allowing the Jedi to take her.<ref name="Backlash" />
